target_queries_note: No GSC data for /it/abn (IT launched days ago; agents/it.json has no gsc_3m for this URL). Queries chosen from native Italian usage: Italian backpacker sites call the ABN 'partita IVA australiana' (justaustralia.it H1 'Partita IVA in Australia: ABN'), and the how-to intent ('come richiedere') dominates the Italian SERP, which is today filled by English pages (lawpath) and Stripe. Our page answers none of the how-to or 'partita IVA' intent in title, H1 area or lede.

competitors.what_they_have: Italian-native. H1 'Partita IVA in Australia: ABN'. Defines ABN as the Australian partita IVA, 11 digits, free online registration, what you need (TFN, passport, phone, address), 'Quando richiedere un ABN?' and 'Che differenza c'è tra TFN e ABN?' H2s, invoice contents, GST mentioned without the figure, TFN only after arrival. No FAQ block, no sources, no dates, no employee vs contractor test. This is the page to beat for the Italian vocabulary.

English, ranks for the Italian how-to query. '2026 Update' in title (freshness signal), short 'not always' answer up front, 11-digit definition, ABN and TFN both free, 'set money aside for tax' warning. Weak: tax rates stated 'as of 2021' (32.5%, stale), says ABN cannot be obtained without a TFN (ABR says TFN only speeds identification), no GST threshold, no sham contracting, no FAQ.
Italian-language TFN vs ABN comparison that ranks for 'ABN o TFN differenza'. Business audience, side-by-side definitions. Nothing on working holiday visas, withholding at 15%, or contractor status.
English, ranks top 1 for the Italian and English queries. Do I need an ABN on a WHV, steps to apply, insurance angle. No Italian, no figures with dates or official sources.

changes.new_text:
L’ABN (Australian Business Number) è il numero di 11 cifre con cui lavori come sole trader in Australia, quello che molti italiani chiamano «partita IVA australiana». Con il visto 417 o 462 si richiede gratis sull’Australian Business Register, ma solo per un vero lavoro autonomo: per un lavoro da dipendente non ne hai diritto.

E cambia la tua tax return: reddito senza ritenute, spese d’impresa, una scelta sulla GST e una domanda sotto tutte e tre: eri davvero un contractor?

facts.fact: ABN is a unique 11-digit number; it does not replace the TFN.
It is free to register for an ABN through the Australian Business Register.
Complete applications get the outcome immediately; reviews can take up to 20 business days.
A TFN is not stated as mandatory; applications are processed faster when you can be identified from details such as your TFN; incomplete applications may be delayed.
You're not entitled to an ABN for work you carry out as an employee; employers should not require an ABN as a condition of employment.
You have 28 days after becoming aware of a change to update your ABN details; cancel when you stop running the business.
Ride-sourcing drivers must have an ABN and register for GST regardless of how much they earn; GST registration requires an ABN.

13 March 2026: ATO and Fair Work Ombudsman joint focus on sham contracting; ATO data-matches ABN records with tax returns, super reporting and Single Touch Payroll; workers engaged principally for their labour are entitled to super.
Working holiday maker tax rate 15% on the first $45,000, effective 1 July 2026, unchanged from 2025-26.
Approved Italian sign-off sentence already on the site: 'Rivista e approvata da un agente fiscale registrato prima di essere presentata all’ATO.'
